tiers.name: Launch
tiers.audience: First-time digital businesses — hawker stalls, home-based traders, brand-new founders
tiers.description: For a brand-new business putting up its very first website, with no existing digital presence to build on.
tiers.note: Excludes 8% SST; domain/hosting/SSL renew at RM549/year from year 2. The MSME Digital Grant MADANI requires 6+ months of SSM registration, so most Launch clients aren't eligible yet — ask us once you hit that milestone.

tiers.name: Expand
tiers.audience: Businesses 1+ year in, already profitable, and ready to invest in growing digitally
tiers.description: For a business that's been running a year or more, turning a modest profit, and ready to move from "just surviving" to a proper digital foundation for growth.
features: 5–8 page custom website, redesigned or built from scratch
Google / Meta Ads account setup, first campaign live
Brand refresh: logo tidy-up, colour & type guide
tiers.note: Grant-eligible — the MSME Digital Grant MADANI matches 50% of this package, up to RM5,000, for SMEs registered 6+ months with SSM. Excludes 8% SST.

tiers.name: Grow
tiers.audience: SMEs 3+ years in, ready to redesign, revamp, and run proper marketing — without an in-house developer
tiers.description: For an established SME that's outgrown its current site or process, wants a real redesign plus ongoing marketing, and needs a technical partner since there's no developer on staff.
features: Full website redesign or revamp, up to 10 pages
UX audit + new UI design system
One internal tool: booking, inventory, or admin dashboard, scoped to your workflow
Social media management: content calendar, posting, community replies (3 months)
Monthly analytics reporting with clear next actions
Care Plan included for 3 months: hosting, updates, up to 2 edits/month
Direct access to the person building it, no account-manager layer
tiers.note: Grant-eligible — the MSME Digital Grant MADANI matches 50% of this package, up to RM5,000. Excludes 8% SST.

tiers.name: Scale
tiers.audience: Corporate teams with multiple staff needing new systems, deeper analytics, and automation
tiers.description: For a larger organisation with multiple departments that needs real systems built or rebuilt, sales and marketing backed by data, and processes automated instead of run by hand.
features: Custom CMS, admin dashboard, or ERP modules (inventory, orders, reporting)
Role-based access control across teams and departments
Integration with existing tools: accounting, CRM, payment gateways
Growth strategy and analytics-led marketing plan
tiers.note: Excludes 8% SST. Scoped and quoted individually after a discovery call.

tiers.name: Custom
tiers.audience: Large-scale, grant-funded, or AI/ML-heavy projects that don't fit a template
tiers.description: For big builds: bespoke platforms, grant-funded digitalisation projects, or serious AI/ML work, scoped and resourced individually rather than boxed into a fixed package.
features: Bespoke architecture for complex or high-scale platforms
Custom AI/ML model integration, not just an LLM wrapper
Grant eligibility review and application support (Geran Digital PMKS, MADANI, and others)
Full-stack team sized to the project
Compliance documentation for grant disbursement and audit
Support through the grant's reporting period
tiers.note: Priced individually after a discovery call — no fixed figure fits every project at this scale.
